title: jmap-server: resolve #creationId refs across method calls
description: RFC 8620 §5.3: a creation id may be referenced as "#<creationId>" in any later method call of the same request. Dispatcher::dispatch accumulates createdIds only when the client sent createdIds and never rewrites #refs in later calls' arguments, so no handler can resolve them. draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00 (jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8) L277 and L306 rely on it ("graphId: #g" in GraphNode/set after Graph/set; fromId/toId "#a"/"#b" in GraphEdge/set), as does its L354-393 example; RFC 8621 Email/set mailboxIds "#m" has the same gap. Fix in jmap-server (canonical foundation): track creation-id -> id for every /set response in the request and substitute #refs in later calls' Id-typed arguments (or expose the map to handlers). Found while implementing JMAP-ef3q.2.
